# Camera giao thông TP.HCM

> Public traffic-camera viewer for Ho Chi Minh City, maintained by ePlus.DEV.

Canonical site: https://camera-hcm.eplus.dev/
Language: Vietnamese (vi-VN)

## Primary resources

- Homepage and searchable camera directory: https://camera-hcm.eplus.dev/
- Sitemap index: https://camera-hcm.eplus.dev/sitemap.xml
- Dynamic camera sitemap: https://camera-hcm.eplus.dev/sitemap.php
- Machine-readable camera catalog: https://camera-hcm.eplus.dev/data-camera.json
- Agent guidance: https://camera-hcm.eplus.dev/agents.md

## Camera pages

Each camera has a canonical server-rendered detail page:

https://camera-hcm.eplus.dev/camera.php?id={CamId}

Camera IDs are 24-character hexadecimal identifiers.

## Data notes

Camera availability and images depend on the public upstream traffic-camera source. Images may be temporarily unavailable. Do not interpret a missing image as proof that a road or camera no longer exists.
